recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, close-up profile portrait of a man looking right, set against a neutral, slightly vignetted background. The composition features a bold, condensed red header in the top right and a secondary line of text with extreme letter-spacing cutting across the center-right negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's gaze directs the viewer toward the negative space containing the typography.
The vibrant red of the primary text contrasts sharply with the muted, cool-toned background.
The extreme horizontal tracking of the subtitle mimics the 'fine line' concept mentioned in the text.
coreInvariants: Strict profile view of the subject.
Neutral, off-white to light gray background with subtle gradient.
Top-right alignment for the primary display text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left half of the frame, cropped at the shoulder and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bold red block of text in the upper right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze to the right, then moves up to the red header and down to the spaced subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large area of open, light-colored space on the right side provides balance to the heavy visual weight of the portrait.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between subject and background; high saturation only in the primary text.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses heavy, tall, condensed forms with minimal apertures.
Secondary text uses light-weight, wide-set geometric forms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard font characteristics and extreme typesetting.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast in weight, width, and tracking between a dense red header and a sparse black subtitle.

preserve: Condensed nature of the top text
Extreme tracking of the middle text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the primary header.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or Gill Sans Light
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric skeleton needed for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in profile looking right. Use high-contrast lighting to define the jawline and brow. The background should be a clean, light-gray wall with a subtle vignette. Leave the right half of the image as empty negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in the top right corner using an extra-condensed bold sans-serif in bright red. Below it, at the level of the subject's nose, add the secondary title in a light black sans-serif with extreme letter spacing so it spans the width of the negative space.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text a bold, condensed red sans-serif?
Is the secondary text extremely wide-tracked?
Is the subject in a strict profile view?
Is there significant negative space on the right side?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for typography
Exact vertical position of the subtitle
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
Original artist name and album title text

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's profile

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text does not bleed into the background.
Check that the wide-tracked text is legible and evenly spaced.
Verify the profile crop does not feel cramped at the top.
Confirm the lighting creates a clear silhouette against the light background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast profile portrait with a split-hierarchy typographic layout: one dense, saturated block and one airy, wide-tracked line.
